title: Misdoubt
summary: MISDOUBT, verb transitive misdout'. [See Doubt.] To suspect of deceit or danger. [An ill formed word and not in use.] MISDOUBT', noun Suspicion of crime or danger. [Not used.] 1. Irresolution; hesitat
